name: Sample Text Kit
description: A harmless demonstration integration. It needs no other program: it counts words, writes a small report and shows how long-running jobs and permissions behave.

requirements.text: Nothing to install. It does not start or change any other program.

commands.label: Count words in text
commands.description: Counts the words, lines and characters of the text you give it. Changes nothing.

commands.label: Write a small text report
commands.description: Writes report.txt (title, word count and the text) into this project's external folder.

commands.label: Count slowly (long job)
commands.description: Counts to the number of seconds you choose, reporting progress. Runs as a job you can watch and cancel.

commands.label: Check the isolation of this integration
commands.description: Tries to start a program and to write outside its folder from inside the integration, and reports that the operating system refused both.
